This name is associated with the supreme deity, Lord Vishnu. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
